newsitem.title: USA: Atlas appoints Mario Caron interim CEO.
newsitem.headline: Atlas appoints Mario Caron interim CEO.

text.p: Atlas Corp said on Wednesday it named Mario Caron interim chief executive officer.
Caron joined Atlas as a director on September 13 and has been acting as a management consultant, Atlas said.
Caron replaced David Birkenshaw, who resigned from the company in June to pursue opportunities elsewhere, the company said.
Atlas said Caron had over 20 years of underground mining expertise in both gold and base metals industries and was most recently chief executive officer of MSV Resources Inc.
